data.one_liner: A plugin for dynamically changing app icons and app badge numbers.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to programmatically change their app icon at runtime and update the application icon badge number.
use_when: You want to give users the ability to customize the app icon from within the app settings
You need to manage and update application badge numbers
avoid_when: You require cross-platform dynamic app icon support without iOS limitations
You are not prepared to manually configure platform-specific settings like Info.plist
strengths: Allows setting and retrieving badge numbers
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration in Info.plist for iOS
Changing icons via private API uses unsupported methods that risk App Store rejection
data.setup_notes: Requires configuring alternate icon files outside of Assets.xcassets and modifying Info.plist on iOS.
